title: Implosion problems finished per month by the Los Alamos punched-card group, as Feynman told it and as the records show
description: Bar chart, problems per month. In Feynman's telling, three problems in nine months before he took over (0.33 a month) and nine in three months after (3 a month). In the laboratory's records as Lewis and Archer read them, eight problems between April and December 1944 (about 0.9 a month) and twelve between April and July 1945 (3 a month). Data: Feynman, Los Alamos from Below (1976); Lewis, Trinity by the Numbers (2021); Archer, The Los Alamos Computing Facility during the Manhattan Project (2021).
heading: IBM GROUP · PROBLEMS FINISHED PER MONTH
